## 简体中文

### 亮点

- 在 DNS 编辑器中新增可选择的 Linux 系统 DNS 监听地址。
- 动态列出主机清单中的本地 IPv4 地址，并以 `127.0.0.1` 作为默认监听地址。
- 新增 `0.0.0.0` 全接口选项；选择后会与其他监听地址互斥。
- 在新核心/配置处于 10 秒健康检查窗口时，明确待生效运行提示。

### 修复

- 保护 Linux 透明代理处理中的 FakeIP 路由捕获。
- 移除临时的手动工作流入口，使 Release 创建继续只由标签推送触发。
- 为每个地址生成 sing-box 系统 DNS inbound，并逐一校验监听就绪状态。

### 验证

- 打标签前通过本地构建、Go 测试、UI 测试、站点测试、安装器冒烟测试、lint 和 TypeScript 检查。
- Release 工作流将发布标准平台二进制、bundle、校验和、SBOM 和内置 UI。

- [完整更新记录](https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v0.3.2...v0.3.3)

## English

### Highlights

- Adds selectable Linux system DNS listener addresses in the DNS editor.
- Dynamically lists local IPv4 addresses from the host inventory, with `127.0.0.1` as the default listener.
- Adds `0.0.0.0` as an explicit all-interface option; selecting it makes other listener addresses mutually exclusive.
- Clarifies the pending runtime message while a new core/configuration is in the 10-second health-check window.

### Fixes

- Protects FakeIP route capture in Linux transparent proxy handling.
- Keeps release creation tied to tag pushes by removing the temporary manual workflow dispatch entry.
- Generates per-address sing-box system DNS inbounds and validates readiness for each selected listener.

### Verification

- Passed local build, Go tests, UI tests, site tests, installer smoke test, lint, and TypeScript checks before tagging.
- Release workflow is expected to publish the standard platform binaries, bundles, checksums, SBOMs, and bundled UI.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v0.3.2...v0.3.3
